text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Are my eyes deceivin' me, or is that a grilled squid stall?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross suddenly gets excited as we pass by the station.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Now that's somethin' ya don't see here too often! People in Tokyo usually just grill the whole thing skewered on a stick!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: All right, lemme grab a quick bite…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Actually, hold on… If I eat this now, I won't have any space for dinner later…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But I could save it for tonight, and have it as a bedtime snack! We could squeeze that into my diet, right Trainer?
choice_data_list: No, it's not good to eat right before going to bed.
Sure. It's not good to suppress your cravings.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Urk… I know that, but… grilled squid battered up Naniwa style is real hard to come by…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But if I'm gonna take care of my body, I can't be snackin' late at night… Gotta… resist… the temptation!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fighting against her instincts, Tamamo Cross resists the urge to try the tempting grilled squid.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You really get it! Holdin' back's the worst thing ya can do! No doubt!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hang tight, I'm gonna go grab some! Oh, and I'd better grab an extra helping for Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so Tamamo Cross gets her grilled squid and comes away with both a full stomach and a full heart.
